user.title: Set up Putzplan
user.description: Putzplan stores all cleaning tasks in Home Assistant and exposes each task as a sensor.

data.seed: Create example tasks (kitchen, bathroom, living room, bedroom, general)

mark_done.name: Mark as done
mark_done.description: Sets the last-done date of a task (default: today).

room.name: Room
room.description: Room the task is listed under.

interval_days.name: Interval (days)
interval_days.description: Every N days; 0 or empty = as needed.

last_done.name: Last done
last_done.description: Optional: when the task was last done.

update_task.name: Update task
update_task.description: Changes name, room, icon, interval or last-done date.

remove_task.name: Remove task
remove_task.description: Deletes a task and its sensor.
